response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile senior engineer, but the profile does not match this role's core requirements. Professional C++ experience is limited to a ~7-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015, far short of the mandatory 5–10 years of hands-on Windows C++. There is no Fixed Income, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience (RIDE Capital was a startup-style fintech, not capital markets), and no evident SQL Server/Oracle depth. Only peripheral desirables (CI/CD, scripting, some Java) are covered.
strengths: Broad, senior-level engineering experience with strong testing and craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD)
Low-latency, high-throughput systems experience (DLang async I/O at Dunnhumby) suggesting solid systems fundamentals
Covers several desirables: CI/CD, scripting languages, some Java exposure
concerns: Minimal professional C++ experience (~7 months, a decade ago) versus the mandatory 5–10 years on Windows
No Fixed Income, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience
No demonstrated SQL Server or Oracle expertise (background is MongoDB/MySQL)

key_factors.factor: No capital markets / fixed income domain knowledge
Strong general engineering and systems fundamentals
